findingDetails.title: Goal completion gates still require ten iterations after both phases were amended to fifteen
findingDetails.evidence: Parent goal D3 remains at ten while parent/phase specs and completed phase evidence record fifteen.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the parent and child goal completion gates to fifteen and reference the superseding ADR.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Cited goal, spec, and task artifacts are inside the reviewed parent and child packet.

findingDetails.title: The P0 write-boundary checklist is marked met while its evidence records spec.md writes
findingDetails.evidence: CHK-031 claims no file outside research/ was written but the same evidence cell says bounded spec.md edits occurred; the parent spec and phase summary authorize and confirm those edits.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite the criterion to distinguish authorized bounded spec.md edits from prohibited writes and attach path-level evidence.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The contradiction is in reviewed task, scope, and summary files; this review made no target changes.

findingDetails.title: Acceptance metadata says In Progress while the same phase packets declare closure
findingDetails.evidence: Both acceptance files say In Progress while their closure statements say Closeable: Yes and all eleven criteria are met; summaries and the parent map say Complete.
findingDetails.recommendation: Align each acceptance status field with the completed status used by the summaries and parent map.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The mismatch is inside both child acceptance files and their parent packet.

findingDetails.title: The summary says a dispatch temp file remains even though the completion evidence says it was deleted
findingDetails.evidence: The summary says the iteration-12 temp file is kept; CHK-050 says executor leftovers were deleted, and the exact reported path is absent now.
findingDetails.recommendation: Remove the stale limitation or replace it with the cleanup disposition and evidence.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The current existence check was read-only and targeted the exact path from the summary.
